title: Ball Movement | Exact Prediction + All Balls + Bank Shot
features:
PREDICTION LINES

• Game-Engine Accuracy — Runs the game's actual physics behind the scenes so the lines match real shots perfectly. No guesswork involved.

• Auto Backup System — Instantly switches to a built-in backup tracer if the game's engine ever fails to load, so your lines never vanish.

• Full Cue Ball Path — Shows exactly where the cue ball will roll, including up to 3 cushion bounces.

• Target Ball Lines — See where the ball you hit is heading, along with its own bank bounces and deflections.

• Pocket & Scratch Alerts — Turns into a ring marker when a ball is going in, and warns you in bright red if the cue ball is about to scratch.

• Bank Shot Markers — Clean rings show the exact spot a ball will bounce off the cushions.

• Combo & Double Hits — Predicts chain reactions so you can plan combo shots and see secondary collisions.

• Real Ball Colors — Every guideline uses the matching color of the ball you're aiming at, so the table stays easy to read.

• Resting Spots — Shows ghost circles right where each ball will finally stop moving on the table.

• Stripe & Solid Identifiers — Ghost markers for balls 9 to 15 have stripe bands on them, making it easy to spot your targets at a glance.
